cleanup.barriers: No barriers; fringing reef diverts some mats.
cleanup.cleanup: Roatán municipality and marine park groups run occasional cleanups.
cleanup.resort: West Bay and north-shore resorts rake mornings.
cleanup.speed: West Bay rarely affected; east/north shores cleared within a day or two.

safety.advisory: US State Dept: Honduras, Level 3 (verify; Bay Islands generally lower risk)
notes: Mainland crime high, especially San Pedro Sula; Bay Islands much safer
